notes.title: New map mode out now!
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce this new feature now added to the game.
Maps are the core of StarPicker gameplay. Then a new map display option means a lot more than just a small update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39584404/b723f93779f67cff8b206d568ece978e95c9591a.jpg[/img]

When you start the game, you now are asked to select your map display preference.
You have the choice between the original map display or the advanced mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39584404/1fde61095a7f396a714b86821dce35b205d73902.jpg[/img]

The advanced mode uses ISOM standards for Orienteering mapping. The map reading is more difficult for beginners, but the regular navigators might find it more useful!
If you already have a saved game you can activate the feature in the option menu.

Here are some StarPicker map samples with the feature activated:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39584404/f13e7c893bd6fac20e3ea7eaa511d3a058ea93b5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39584404/b9582e6c6a93ae05a2c075fe22a247bcb0ec1d2d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39584404/3eff3645402336c5bff98c204a39a50c3cf5f87a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39584404/852ee06735e7f219c19a1b3fa48f76f421842a33.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39584404/50bfce2aac94d78925e9b13a471192873ee84afb.jpg[/img]

Maps display will continuously be improved, so be sure to stay tuned.

Have fun!!! =)
